settings.name: shop_checkout
settings.label: Checkout provider
settings.help: Panel that handles checkout handoff (from modules that provide shop_checkout).||Leave empty until configured — cart will show an error on the checkout button.

settings.name: image_compose
settings.label: Image compose
settings.help: Optional. Warp/composite product artwork onto a print background.||Empty: use the only installed provider, or skip if none.

settings.name: default_currency_id
settings.label: Default currency
settings.help: Main shop currency. Product base price is in this currency. Other currencies use product overrides or rate × base.

settings.name: cart_hold_minutes
settings.label: Cart hold (minutes)
settings.help: A draft cart reserves stock-counted items this long after the visitor last added to or opened the cart. Older carts do not reserve stock.

settings.name: cart_delete_days
settings.label: Delete carts after (days)
settings.help: Unpaid carts with no visitor activity for this many days are deleted by the repeating task Shop cart cleanup. 0 = never. Orders are never deleted.

settings.name: show_tax
settings.label: Show tax
settings.help: On-site checkout page only (shop/checkout, delivery tax multipliers). The product page and cart use VAT below.

settings.name: vat_rate
settings.label: VAT rate (%)
settings.help: Empty: N/A (not VAT registered), the product page and cart show the N/A text.||A number, e.g. 20: prices include VAT at this rate; the product page says so and the cart shows the VAT part of the total.

settings.name: vat_product_text
settings.label: Product page
settings.help: Under the price when there is a rate. {{rate}} = the rate.

settings.name: vat_cart_text
settings.label: Cart total
settings.help: Under the cart total when there is a rate. {{amount}} = the VAT part of the total: total × rate / (100 + rate).

settings.name: vat_na_text
settings.label: N/A text
settings.help: Product page and cart when the rate is empty. Empty: no line.

settings.name: emails
settings.label: Notification emails
settings.help: Get the New order email when an order is paid. Texts: Shop settings → Order emails.
